{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

print(f'Mean biomarker_final across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final:.2f} ng/mL')"}
